adjudication.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` when `ZAddGuestsInputSchema.safeParse(multiEmailValue)` fails, but it is only reset on the Cancel button click (`setIsInvalidEmail(false)`). The `onSuccess` handler resets `multiEmailValue` and closes the dialog but does not reset `isInvalidEmail`. Since `<AddGuestsDialog ... />` is always rendered in `BookingListItem` (not conditionally unmounted), the dialog component state can persist across close/reopen via `isOpenDialog`, so the red error banner can remain visible after reopening or even after a successful add.
